text: My daily routine is built on consistency, which helps me stay productive and relaxed. I start every morning at six-thirty with a glass of water and a short stretch. After a quick breakfast of oatmeal and fruit, I review my schedule for the day. By eight, I’m at my desk, where I focus on my main work tasks until noon, taking a ten-minute break every hour. In the early afternoon, I do a thirty-minute workout, usually a mix of jogging and strength exercises. This energizes me for the rest of the shift. Evenings are for winding down: I cook dinner, read for about half an hour, and write in my journal. I’m in bed by ten, ready to repeat the cycle.
